headline: Nairobi Financial Hub Plans Sh65bn Fund for Kenyan Startups
summary: A Nairobi financial hub plans to establish a Sh65 billion fund to back Kenyan startups, with half of the capital earmarked for technology and artificial intelligence enterprises.
why: Venture capital availability fuels regional technology development and expands the startup ecosystem in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Technology Startups
impacts.why: Access to a large dedicated fund directly supports capital formation and growth for early-stage companies.
